type prototypes
subroutine ExitProcess(ulong exit_code) library "kernel32.dll"
end prototypes

event open;
u_hello greeter
integer result, output_file
greeter = create u_hello
result = greeter.greet()
destroy greeter
output_file = FileOpen("greet-return.txt", LineMode!, Write!, LockWrite!, Replace!)
if output_file > 0 then
    FileWrite(output_file, String(result))
    FileClose(output_file)
end if
ExitProcess(result)
end event

build.cmd.content_utf8:
@echo off
reg add "HKLM\Software\Sybase\PowerBuilder Runtime\22.2.0.3289" /v Location /t REG_SZ /d "%CD%" /f /reg:32
if errorlevel 1 exit /b %errorlevel%
orca_import.exe
if errorlevel 1 exit /b %errorlevel%
if not exist corpus_hello.pbl exit /b 20
if not exist corpus_hello.exe exit /b 21
observe_message.exe
exit /b %errorlevel%

portable-wrapper.sh.content_utf8:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
"$@" &
pid=$!
trap 'kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
status=0
wait "$pid" || status=$?
if [ -n "${CORPUS_WINESERVER:-}" ]; then
    "$CORPUS_WINESERVER" -w
fi
exit "$status"

virtual_display: Own Xvfb server with no display attached to the user desktop.
toolchain: Appeon PowerBuilder 2022 R3 22.2.0.3289, native ORCA and Runtime x86, Wine 11.10
reproduction_command: In the isolated Wine prefix run build.cmd, which invokes orca_import.exe and observe_message.exe
semantic_scope: The genuine Appeon compiler imported the unchanged u_hello.sru into a local library and built a test application that calls greet(). The matching runtime showed the exact greeting and the function returned 0. The observer read the dialog in a private virtual display and the process exited with code 0. The test application passes the method result to Win32 ExitProcess after writing it to a local result file.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
